messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the authz incident thread — collecting owners and timelines for remediation. TL;DR: token validation gaps + missing audit entries + some stale permissions + secrets rotation checklist. I'll propose owners below. :memo:

maria: Thanks. can we split into (1) token validation harness (2) audit log backfill + alerts (3) perm audit + remediations (4) secrets rotation plan?

alex: yes. proposed owners:
- token validation harness -> alex
- audit backfill + alerts -> maria
- permissions remediation -> sam
- secrets rotation (service accounts) -> kevin

kevin: ack. can we get target dates? is a week reasonable for harness?

alex: target: token harness by 2026-03-27 (EOD PST)
maria: audit backfill & alerting by 2026-04-03. will need a small script + query, adding to my board.
sam: perms remediation - I'll triage high-risk roles this week, aim for rollouts next Tue 2026-03-31.
kevin: secrets rotation plan draft by 2026-03-29; I'll schedule a short runbook review.

maria: adding quick query we'll use for backfill:
```
SELECT service, count(*) as failures
FROM auth_audit
WHERE event='token_validation' AND success=false AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY failures DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

sam: PR for partial perms cleanup: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/873 (contains list, will iterate)

alex: ops note — temporary mitigation: we enabled stricter token ttl enforcement in staging and prod-2 (deployed at 11:12 UTC). deployment log:
```
deploy-bot: cluster/prod-2 token-ttl-enforcer v1.3 deployed
status: success
```

audit-bot: New audit entries detected for failed token validations. Count: 18 in the last hour. See /audit-dashboard (link)

kevin: We should schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow to confirm owners and blockers. @maria @sam @alex agree?

maria: yes :+1:

alex: scheduled — calendar invite sent for 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. Agenda: blockers, owners, quick PR reviews. I'll update the follow-up tracker after the meeting.

sam: adding recurring check for token validation trends to weekly runbook (cc: ops-sre)

kevin: noted. once harness is in, let's add automated regression alert if failure rate > 0.5% over 1h.

alex: Action items summary (I'll paste to the postmortem doc):
- alex: token validation harness, 2026-03-27
- maria: audit backfill + alerting, 2026-04-03
- sam: permissions remediation (high-risk), 2026-03-31
- kevin: secrets rotation plan + runbook, 2026-03-29

maria: I'll add OWNER labels to the postmortem and assign Jira tickets.

alex: cool. tagging incident team for visibility: @security @eng-sre

kevin: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
